title: Angry Chick in Mosaic Tree
description: A vibrant mosaic-style surreal painting depicts a large twisted tree growing from a pond, its branches filled with black cats with glowing eyes. A yellow chick with an angry expression and red boxing gloves stands on a branch in front of a radiant sunburst. The scene includes a colorful tiled sky, distant houses, lily pads, and a clear reflection of the chick and tree in the rippling water below.
